_notes: Hotspot positions are normalized (0-1 of image width/height) so they scale at any display size.
Zones reflect approximate wildfire risk: A = canyon-edge / wildland-urban-interface (highest), B = adjacent fuel, C = neighborhood-interior, D = deep urban / commercial.
Coordinator + ham-operator contact fields are intentionally null — PNEC publishes those by email request only (privacy). The contact_protocol field tells users how to actually reach their NEC.

global_protocol.sd_emergency_app: Search 'SD Emergency' on iOS or Android

neighborhoods.name: Heritage II — Northpointe
neighborhoods.evac_guidance: North/west edge of city — fire approach most likely from N. Drive S on Espola or W on Twin Peaks toward I-15.
neighborhoods.notes: Backs to open chaparral on the Escondido side.
neighborhoods.fhsz_advice: Highest wildfire risk. Zone Zero (0–5 ft) hardening is CRITICAL — no combustibles, no wood fences attached to home, no mulch. Schedule a free HIZ assessment with PNEC. Leave EARLY on red-flag days — do not wait for an order.

block_party.pitch: PNEC sends a volunteer to your neighborhood block party with kit demos, NEC introductions, and a 15-minute preparedness talk — completely free. Email powaynec@gmail.com with neighborhood #1 to schedule.
